source: Now, after getting the chance to be closer with you, I started to see things differently…
translation: 如今，在有机会和你更加亲近后，我开始以不同的方式看待事情……

source: I’m afraid that I’d lose someone I love again…
translation: 我害怕自己会再次失去所爱之人……

source: All of a sudden there was a hole in my heart…
translation: 突然间，我的心里出现了一个空洞……

source: All that was left in me was the promise that we made to each other, so I did everything in my power to make Camp Buddy the best it could be…
translation: 我心中只剩下我们彼此许下的承诺，所以我竭尽全力让 Camp Buddy 变得尽可能好……

source: I owe that place so much for allowing me to become a better version of myself, to bond with my daughter, and most importantly… to have met you.
translation: 我太亏欠那个地方了，它让我成为更好的自己，让我与女儿建立联系，更重要的是……让我遇见你。

source: In my mind, I was going to make it big and successful by the time you came back… thinking it would make you, my daughter, and myself happy.
translation: 我心里想着，等你回来时，我要让它变得庞大而成功……以为那会让你、我的女儿和我自己都幸福。

source: I never knew how truly lonely I was…
translation: 我从不知道自己竟如此孤独……

source: I even pushed my own daughter away, assigning her to a different place, and shutting down any attempts she made to reach me…
translation: 我甚至推开自己的女儿，把她分配到别处，并阻断她试图接近我的任何努力……

source: I let no one see my weakness, and it started a vicious cycle where I grew more and more bitter each day for letting you go…
translation: 我不让任何人看到我的软弱，这开始形成恶性循环，让我因放开你而每天变得更加苦涩……

source: Even when we were reunited, it took me so long to break the walls I had built up…
translation: 即使我们重逢后，我也花了很长时间才打破自己筑起的高墙……

source: But with time… you slowly mended my broken heart…
translation: 但随着时间推移……你慢慢修复了我破碎的心……

source: And now, we’ve grown into something I could only wish for…
translation: 而现在，我们已经成长为我曾经只能期盼的模样……

source: I don’t want to risk letting you go again… because everything I want is already here...
translation: 我不想冒险再次放开你……因为我想要的一切已经在这里……

source: You’re right… We’ve already reached our dream… We’re together again and leading the camp side by side.
translation: 你说得对……我们已经实现梦想……我们再次在一起，并肩领导营地。

source: I was hoping you would feel the same way once you heard my reason… but I still should’ve told you.
translation: 我希望你听到我的理由后会有同样的感受……但我仍然应该告诉你。

source: I think I understand now… You don’t deserve to suffer like that again, just because we aren’t satisfied with what we have…
translation: 我想我现在明白了……你不该仅仅因为我们不满足于已有的一切，就再次承受那种痛苦……

source: I’m very grateful for all the amazing things that happened and the lessons I’ve learned along the way, but I’m more than satisfied with what we’ve achieved…
translation: 我非常感激一路发生的所有美好事情和学到的教训，但我对我们已经取得的成果十分满足……

source: It’s not that I’m giving up on our dream, but that I’m ready to move on to a different chapter…
translation: 不是说我要放弃我们的梦想，而是我准备走向不同的篇章……

source: And that chapter is with you, Yoshinori…
translation: 而那个篇章有你，Yoshinori……

source: For once in my life, the path is clear and I know what I want for the future…
translation: 在我人生中难得的一次，前路清晰，我知道自己想要怎样的未来……

source: Not only have you taught me how to love again, but you also showed me what it’s like to be truly loved…
translation: 你不仅教会我如何再次去爱，也让我知道真正被爱是什么感觉……

source: I know this might be sudden... But I’ve been preparing for this moment for a long time, and only today did I have the courage to do anything…
translation: 我知道这可能很突然……但我为这一刻准备了很久，直到今天才有勇气做些什么……

source: I’ve had these feelings for so long… And I’m ready for them to be set in stone...
translation: 我拥有这些感情很久了……我准备让它们成为永恒的承诺……

source: I want to live the rest of my life with you… To be partners in heart and soul…
translation: 我想和你共度余生……成为心灵与灵魂上的伴侣……

source: Will you be forever by my side…?
translation: 你愿意永远在我身边吗……？

source: Yes…!
translation: 我愿意……！

source: {i}(As I accepted Goro’s proposal, I was overwhelmed with emotion…){/i}
translation: {i}（当我接受 Goro 的求婚时，我被情绪淹没……）{/i}

source: {i}(I never thought this moment would come…){/i}
translation: {i}（我从没想过这一刻会到来……）{/i}

source: {i}(For as long as I’ve known him, Goro has always sacrificed for the sake of others and let go of his own happiness…){/i}
translation: {i}（在我认识他的漫长岁月中，Goro 总是为了别人牺牲，放弃自己的幸福……）{/i}

source: {i}(Now, he’s finally pursuing something for himself… And to know that I’m what truly makes him happy, I couldn’t ask for anything more.){/i}
translation: {i}（现在，他终于在追求属于自己的东西……而知道我是真正让他幸福的人，我别无所求。）{/i}

source: I love you too…
translation: 我也爱你……
